# Vendored animation runtime

GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0, copied without modifications from the
official `gsap` npm package. The package version is recorded in package-lock.json.
Keeping these files local lets the static portfolio work without a CDN.

Copyright notices and license links are preserved in both script headers.
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
Source: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP

To update, install the reviewed GSAP version and copy `dist/gsap.min.js` and
`dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js` into this folder.
